name: Value DeFi vSafe StrategyAlpacaWBNB in-flight ibBNB valuation
summary: StrategyAlpacaWBNB values its ibBNB position at Alpaca Vault totalToken()/totalSupply(), and the vSafe WBNB vault mints shares against that value. Inside Alpaca Vault.work() the lent BNB has left the vault before the debt is booked, so totalToken() reads about half its true value. The attacker opened an Alpaca position through a strategy that calls an attacker-chosen farming token, re-entered vSafe depositFor() from that token's approve() at the depressed share price, and redeemed the excess shares at the true price in later transactions.

loss.notes: Vault WBNB paid to the attacker in nine redemptions minus the attacker's own WBNB deposits in the nine re-entrant deposits: 24267.906010457069055632 - 18922.591338882848871944 WBNB. The attacker's deposits are campaign inputs, not victim loss. Alpaca's lent BNB was repaid within each work() call and is excluded. Reported totals near $11m combine other Value DeFi pools and incidents and are not used.

ageReset.description: Immutable StrategyAlpacaWBNB runtime holds the totalToken()-based valuation; the controller counted it in the vault balance from 173 seconds after deployment through the exploit, apart from a 66-second list rewrite that restored it.

limitations: Alpaca's PancakeswapV2StrategyAddBaseTokenOnly (proxy 0xe38ebfe8f314dcad61d5adcb29c1a26f41bed0be, implementation 0x77d23aff927f3d46e51d449372c957b3cbbfb40e) accepts an unvalidated farmingToken and supplied the re-entry callback, but Alpaca's own repayment invariant held and it lost nothing, so it is recorded as the entry path, not a target.

sources.note: Loss. eth_getLogs Transfer on WBNB 0xbb4cdb9cbd36b01bd1cbaebf2de08d9173bc095c and on the vSafe share token 0xd4bbf439d3eab5155ca7c0537e583088fb4cfce8, blocks 7216000..7230000, with from or to equal to attacker EOA 0xcb36b1ee0af68dce5578a487ff2da81282512233 or its contract 0x4269e4090ff9dfc99d8846eb0d42e67f01c3ac8b. Each transfers the attacker's whole WBNB balance to the vault and mints vSafe shares to the EOA; the next attacker-contract call (selector 0x5e7ab248) burns them for more WBNB: 0xa2351f51fb9ea0a0a1b50336a549ac688be6d5eb375284a2de3e5e8381e64f4a, 0x06924f186f9bab0408f4b18d104ce003b8bc45ac10824f0d205b831d26e8f3d7, 0x42d15407a5ad2a00f8cb9c2c65b43be13db7a93441db2729da56d525b64d935b, 0x5ee774a1ef98b1c745ac93d09e74a4976de5b86402b6178dc3aa7c9ae2239879, 0x158c9fe2abde339b689476cee646d63c2f7c605af4b16b4e32d68643d5af6d92, 0x02a28e429b9cb11927c195c12a8140c4632f890453fb3e4f265964fe7cd1272b, 0xc00cb16028d112be9f6f6d6fc5e91bb79b2d69c64e8de1a17c4d6f3305041d72, 0x03658a919e0bbf53cb869cefa5b65f1820ba040a227c8b3237b405e0bef4c2ad, 0x9dab872598ee7a6290ed7d6f3a903f44a8794246c3089cc91d6cfb69be4d58b4 (last, block 7223346, timestamp 1620419334). Deposits and redemptions strictly alternate. Sum attacker-to-vault WBNB 18922591338882848871944 base units, vault-to-attacker 24267906010457069055632; difference 5345314671574220183688 (18 decimals). The Alpaca loan leg in each deposit (e.g. 399294.37352293753 WBNB from pair 0xbfa618f7b7078be3b00f5ccfb85907083efab9f0 to the EOA and back to the Alpaca vault in source-1) nets to zero. vSafe share mint events (Transfer from zero) in blocks 7200000..7400000 number 30; the only mints executed inside an Alpaca work() call are the attacker's nine deposit transactions above, all others being ordinary deposit(uint256,uint256) calls to the vault.

Root cause, anchor and age. debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) of source-1 (block 7223030, index 61): the EOA calls Alpaca Vault work(0, worker 0x7af938f0efdd98dc513109f6a7e85106d26e16c4, 1e18, 393652744565353082751500 loan, ...) with strategy 0xe38ebfe8f314dcad61d5adcb29c1a26f41bed0be and data (WBNB, farmingToken 0x4269e409..., 0). The strategy's execute() calls farmingToken.approve(), and the attacker contract re-enters vSafe depositFor(0xcb36..., 0xcb36..., 273813109335418386629, 0) (selector 0xcf4a0c5e). Inside it controller 0x2b4f87d9d0a32a04b2d045fd5927cb57bedb076e balanceOf() calls StrategyAlpacaWBNB.balanceOf(), which reads Alpaca totalToken() = 406037424823916094392996 against totalSupply() = 793300839274045174646136 and returns 31198972667719032274306. At block 7223029 the same calls return totalToken 805330636385668305893420, getAlpacaVaultPricePerFullShare() 1015164230914758237 and balanceOf() 61879735652370629229190, so the in-flight read halves the strategy and the vault mints 399.2021855555172 shares for 273.81 WBNB. Verified source (Etherscan V2 getsourcecode, chainid=56, StrategyAlpacaWBNB, v0.6.12, optimizer 9999 runs; SHA-256 of SourceCode 9cabb4e7472ca5693653ca065ced3b2d64401fff53faf78efb56d7af089eed83): balanceOfPool() multiplies the FairLaunch-staked ibBNB by getAlpacaVaultPricePerFullShare() = totalToken()*1e18/totalSupply(), with no guard against an in-progress work(). The vault's _non_reentrant_ guard does not cover re-entry from Alpaca. Earliest exercise: the EOA's Etherscan txlist before source-1 contains one reverted work() (0x3476fd7b133cf76e435c821a4058bdc84a83b1de87532a728af0ef5c11dac822, block 7223021) and a zero-share redemption at block 7223023; source-1 is the first successful mispriced mint. Age: eth_getCode is empty at block 5409051; keccak256 of the runtime is the recorded hash at deployment block 5409052 and at block 7223029. Source-3 receipt: top-level creation by 0x9696969e67b37403196a3519edc176276714a724 at index 86. Etherscan labels it a non-proxy contract. Controller txlist, blocks 0..7223030, decoded: approveStrategy(0xb434...) at 5409186, setStrategyLength(1) at 5409193, setStrategyInfo(0, 0xb434..., max, 100) at 5409205; every later setStrategyInfo keeps 0xb434... at sid 0 or 1 within strategyLength, changing only quota and percent, except that 0x0982d5f5e7369429e064f63ba140549eb343b057cedd185eef81484452a594a1 (block 7152982) set length 0 and 0xe3547ba8886ef0af31c552a983127ea6499eb58d73888780fabc6f23ecc2ba75 / 0x7a0bacd598d1b34eb850a72a1ff21243f3f1062b82ba15e76e4fda211f01894f (blocks 7152990 / 7153004) put the same strategy back at sid 0 with length 3. strategies(0) at block 7223029 is 0xb434... with percent 40. The initial wiring and that list rewrite only change whether and how much of the vault is exposed to the unchanged valuation code, so the deployment supplies the age.
